Cairns Convention Centre

CCC · Sheridan St & Wharf St, Cairns City QLD 4870

Getting in

  1. Locate the security gate on Sheridan Street and press the intercom at the gate. Tell security you're from Signature Staff Agency and they'll let you in (pictured below).
  2. Arrive 15 minutes before your shift start – you'll need to get through security, change into your uniform, and be ready for your briefing.
  3. Clock in and out outside the security door – reception inside is very limited.
  4. Also sign in and out on the agency paper run sheet at security.
  5. Read through the CCC Handbook before your first shift. Click here.
If you miss your briefing, you'll wait up to 30 minutes, unpaid, for the next one – it pays to be on time.

Uniform

A shirt and trousers are provided – make sure you're wearing the correct footwear for your department (e.g. food & beverage or kitchen) and your name badge.

Managers

  • Bec – Food and Beverage
  • Peter – Venue Presentation
  • Craig – Stewarding
  • Ben – Catering Assistant

Parking

There is no free parking available in the area.

If you have a bike, you can securely lock it inside the venue via the car park.

Green Island Resort

Reef Fleet Terminal, Cairns · boat transfer – no security gate

Getting in

  1. Make sure you have your booking number and know the timetable so you don't miss the boat.
  2. Head to the Reef Fleet Terminal (entrance on Spence Street / Pier Point Road) and go straight to the Great Adventures boat – it's the first boat on the right on the main finger, by the Blue Marlin Cafe and the main terminal building.
  3. Get your ticket from the skipper – don't queue in the main line, go straight to the front as staff.
  4. Clock in when you arrive on the island, and clock out again when you leave.

Parking

There is no free parking around the area.

Pullman Reef Hotel Casino

Cairns

Getting in

  1. Arrive 15 minutes prior to your shift start time to make sure you're through security and at your department on time.
  2. Head to the car park (P1 / Parking Level 1).
  3. Go either through the car park or through the complex – the lift is located behind Bar 36. After getting off the lift, turn right.
  4. Press the intercom – security will open the doors.
  5. Go straight to see security (green doors). They'll give you a security tag – all staff must check in and out with security before and after every shift.
  6. Also sign in and out on the agency run sheet with security.

Click here for the Reef Casino Staff Handbook.

Uniform

Uniform is not provided. Make sure you're wearing the correct uniform, footwear and name badge for the department you're working in.

Sheraton Grand Mirage Port Douglas

Port Douglas

Getting in

  1. Due to the size of the property, arrive no later than 15 minutes before your shift start time.
  2. Park in the lower (larger) car park, to the left of the reception entrance and slightly down the ramp, then head to the loading bay.
  3. Stay on the pedestrian path on your left – the road is used for forklifts and resort buggies and it's a busy delivery bay.
  4. Walk to the end and turn left to find the staff entry. Go through the entrance and you'll find uniforms on your left.
  5. Head through to find the toilets, showers and staff canteen – the kitchen is a right turn at the end of the corridor.
  6. Remember to sign the agency run sheet on site.
Phones may not be used while on shift – if you're caught using yours, you'll be signed out and sent home.

The Ville

The Ville Resort-Casino · Townsville

Getting in

  1. Your induction must be signed before your shift starts.
  2. Arrive 15 minutes prior to your shift start time to allow time to sign in via security and get to your department.
  3. The staff entrance is on the right side of the building – the same side as the Townsville Entertainment & Convention Centre – beside the loading dock (two roller doors) and across from the bench seat.
  4. Proceed up the ramp to the security window and tell the security officer who you are and who you're seeing.

Uniform

White button-up business shirt, black pants and all-black smart shoes, plus your Signature Staff name badge.
